record.paper_title: Ramsey theory of homogeneous structures: current trends and open problems
record.original_question: Develop infinite-dimensional Ramsey theory on spaces of copies of a homogeneous structure. More concretely, extend the Galvin-Prikry and Ellentuck theorems from the Baire-space setting [omega]^omega to subspaces in which each infinite set represents a copy of a fixed homogeneous structure, ideally in a form that also recovers exact big Ramsey degrees.

evidence.quote: Problem 6.4. Develop infinite dimensional Ramsey theory on spaces of copies of a homogeneous structure.
The question in [41] asks for extensions of these theorems to subspaces of [ω]ω , where each infinite set represents a copy of some fixed homogeneous structure.
the infinite dimensional Ramsey theorem should ideally also recover exact big Ramsey degrees.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbf{K}$ be a countable infinite homogeneous relational structure (a Fraïssé limit of a Fraïssé class). A "copy" of $\mathbf{K}$ inside $\mathbf{K}$ is the image of an embedding $\mathbf{K} \hookrightarrow \mathbf{K}$; identify each copy with the corresponding infinite subset of the underlying set $\omega$ of $\mathbf{K}$, so that the space $\mathrm{Cop}(\mathbf{K}) \subseteq [\omega]^{\omega}$ of all copies is a subspace of the Baire space, equipped with the relative topology.

Recall:
(Galvin–Prikry) Every Borel subset of $[\omega]^{\omega}$ is Ramsey: for every $X \in [\omega]^{\omega}$ and every Borel $\mathcal{X} \subseteq [\omega]^{\omega}$, there is $Y \in [X]^{\omega}$ such that $[Y]^{\omega} \subseteq \mathcal{X}$ or $[Y]^{\omega} \cap \mathcal{X} = \emptyset$.
(Ellentuck) A set $\mathcal{X} \subseteq [\omega]^{\omega}$ is completely Ramsey iff it has the Baire property in the Ellentuck topology generated by the basic sets $[s,A] = \{B \in [\omega]^{\omega} : s \sqsubset B \subseteq s \cup A\}$.

The big Ramsey degree of a finite substructure $\mathbf{A} \subseteq \mathbf{K}$ is the least integer $T(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{K})$ (if it exists) such that for every finite coloring of the copies of $\mathbf{A}$ in $\mathbf{K}$, there is a copy $\mathbf{K}' \subseteq \mathbf{K}$ on which the coloring takes at most $T(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{K})$ colors.

Problem. Develop an infinite-dimensional Ramsey theory on the spaces $\mathrm{Cop}(\mathbf{K})$ of copies of an arbitrary countable homogeneous structure $\mathbf{K}$. Specifically, find a natural topology on $\mathrm{Cop}(\mathbf{K})$ (refining the subspace topology from $[\omega]^{\omega}$) and a notion of "Ramsey" subsets of $\mathrm{Cop}(\mathbf{K})$ such that:
(i) every Borel (and ideally every Baire-property) subset of $\mathrm{Cop}(\mathbf{K})$ is Ramsey, yielding direct analogues of the Galvin–Prikry and Ellentuck theorems in this setting;
(ii) the Nash–Williams (front) version of the theorem applied to finite-dimensional colorings recovers the exact big Ramsey degrees $T(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{K})$ of finite substructures $\mathbf{A}$ of $\mathbf{K}$.

Carry out this program in full generality for arbitrary countable homogeneous structures.
artifact.category_tag: Infinite-dimensional Ramsey theory on homogeneous structures
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is partially solved. Coulson, Dobrinen, and Patel established Galvin–Prikry/Ellentuck-style infinite-dimensional Ramsey theorems on spaces of copies of homogeneous structures satisfying the Substructure Disjoint Amalgamation Property SDAP+ (or LSDAP+) in languages with finitely many relation symbols of arity at most two, and as a corollary recovered exact big Ramsey degrees in those cases. The general case for arbitrary homogeneous structures (including those of higher arity or without SDAP+) remains open.

status_evidence.title: Infinite-dimensional Ramsey theory for homogeneous structures with SDAP+
status_evidence.snippet: For any homogeneous structure K in a language with finitely many relation symbols of arity at most two satisfying SDAP+ (or LSDAP+), there are spaces of subcopies of K, forming subspaces of the Baire space, in which all Borel sets are Ramsey.
status_evidence.claim: Galvin-Prikry/Ellentuck-style theorems and exact big Ramsey degrees obtained for the class of homogeneous structures satisfying SDAP+.

status_evidence.title: Galvin-Prikry theorems for big Ramsey structures
status_evidence.snippet: Galvin-Prikry theorems for big Ramsey structures — recent work extending infinite-dimensional Ramsey theory to homogeneous structures.
status_evidence.claim: Active research program extending Galvin-Prikry to big Ramsey structures; not yet fully general.

status_evidence.title: Ramsey theory of homogeneous structures: current trends and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Develops the current state and lists open problems on infinite-dimensional Ramsey theory on spaces of copies of homogeneous structures.
status_evidence.claim: Problem stated as an open direction with known partial progress.
